metas.name: Malice
metas.description: A charming young man works his way into a wealthy family's holiday home as a tutor, and his real motive slowly comes into focus. It is a con-man revenge thriller about a performance played for real, with dread that builds toward a reckoning.

metas.name: Severance
metas.description: Office workers surgically split their work selves from their home selves, and the doubles start to rebel. Precise, eerie, and every episode ends on a hook.

metas.name: Barry
metas.description: A hitman takes up acting, and his roles and his murders start to bleed together. Pitch-black comedy that grows darker every season.

metas.name: Mousetrap
metas.description: A reclusive writer wakes up to find a man called The Rat living his life, and allies with a loan shark to get it back. An identity-theft thriller.

metas.name: The Outsider
metas.description: A beloved coach is arrested for a child's murder despite proof that he was elsewhere, and a double is at work. Grim, slow-burn horror procedural.

metas.name: Inside No. 9
metas.description: A British anthology of half-hour dark tales, each with a vicious final twist. Deadpan, cruel and very bingeable.

metas.name: Dark Matter
metas.description: A physicist is abducted into an alternate version of his life while his double takes over his family. A doppelgänger thriller with momentum.

metas.name: Hannibal
metas.description: An FBI profiler and his psychiatrist, secretly a cannibal, are locked in an elegant battle of minds. Stylish, cruel and precise.
